legal.req.title: Seller details
about.title: About
about.lead: CollabPad ("Living Canvas") is a shared online world where drawings come alive.
about.what.title: What it is
about.what.1: Draw anything right in your browser, draw a loop around it and press ALIVE. A neural network works out what it is, and the drawing comes alive from your own lines: a cow grazes, a wolf hunts, you can drive a car, and a bomb explodes.
about.what.2: There is one world for everyone, and everyone sees it at the same time. There is no undo: every stroke stays forever.
about.free.title: Free
about.free.1: You can enter the world for free, without signing up. Without signing in you get 10 revivals a day; signed in by e-mail, 20. The free version shows ads.
about.plus.title: Plus subscription
about.plus.1: Plus costs {priceMonth} for 30 days or {priceYear} for 365 days. It has no ads, 50 revivals a day and up to 5 private worlds shared by link or by invitation. Guests join private worlds for free.
about.plus.2: Access opens right after payment, for the account that paid. The service is provided online on the website; nothing is delivered physically.
about.pay.title: Payment and refunds
about.pay.1: Payments go through Robokassa, by bank card or another method it offers. Card details are entered on Robokassa's page; this site never receives them. You get an electronic receipt.
about.pay.2: The subscription is never renewed or charged automatically. You can cancel it at any time. You can get your money back for unused days by writing to the support e-mail; the full terms are in the terms of service.
about.contacts.title: Contacts
about.contacts.1: For any question about the site, payments, refunds or personal data, write or call.
offer.title: Terms of service (public offer)
offer.lead: An agreement for access to the Plus subscription on {site}. Version of 20 November 2026.
offer.s1.title: 1. General
offer.s1.1: This document is a public offer (Article 437 of the Civil Code of the Russian Federation). {name}, a professional income tax payer, INN {inn} (the Seller), offers anyone (the User) an agreement on the terms below.
offer.s1.2: Paying for a Plus subscription accepts this offer. The agreement is made at the moment of payment.
offer.s1.3: The free part of the site is available without payment or registration. By using it, the User agrees to the rules in section 5.
offer.s2.title: 2. Subject
offer.s2.1: For the paid period, the Seller gives the User access to the Plus subscription on {site}: the site without ads, up to 50 drawings brought to life a day, and up to 5 private worlds shared by link or by invitation.
offer.s2.2: The service is provided online and counts as provided once access opens. Nothing is delivered physically.
offer.s3.title: 3. Price and payment
offer.s3.1: The subscription costs {priceMonth} for 30 days or {priceYear} for 365 days. Not subject to VAT.
offer.s3.2: Payment is 100% in advance through the Robokassa payment service (ROBOKASSA LLC). The Seller never receives or stores bank card details.
offer.s3.3: After paying, the User receives an electronic receipt.
offer.s3.4: The subscription is never renewed or charged automatically. To extend it, the User pays for a new period, which is added to the current one.
offer.s4.title: 4. Cancellation and refunds
offer.s4.1: The User may cancel the subscription at any time on the plans page; access stays until the end of the paid period.
offer.s4.2: To get money back, the User writes to {email} from the address the account is linked to. Within 10 days of receiving the letter, the Seller refunds the price of the unused whole days of the period, by the same method that was used to pay; Plus access then ends.
offer.s4.3: If access did not open because of an error on the Seller's side, the full amount is refunded.
offer.s5.title: 5. Rules of use
offer.s5.1: Drawings in the shared world are visible to every visitor and are never deleted: there is no undo. The User does not draw anything that breaks Russian law or the rights of other people.
offer.s5.2: Bringing drawings to life relies on a neural network and can make mistakes. Objects in the world follow the rules of the game and can disappear, for example when they are eaten or blown up. This is not a defect of the service.
offer.s5.3: The Seller may restrict access to the site for a User who breaks these rules.
offer.s6.title: 6. Liability
offer.s6.1: The site is provided as is. The Seller tries to keep it running around the clock but is not liable for interruptions caused by network failures, third-party equipment or force majeure.
offer.s6.2: The Seller's liability is limited to the amount the User paid for the current subscription period.
offer.s7.title: 7. Personal data
offer.s7.1: The Seller processes the User's personal data under the privacy policy published on {site}.
offer.s8.title: 8. Other terms
offer.s8.1: The Seller may change this offer by publishing a new version on this page. Changes do not affect a period already paid for.
offer.s8.2: Claims are accepted at {email} and answered within 10 days. Disputes that cannot be settled by negotiation go to court under Russian law.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: Version of 20 November 2026. This policy follows Federal Law No. 152-FZ of 27.07.2006 "On Personal Data" and applies to {site}.
privacy.s1.title: 1. Operator
privacy.s1.1: The personal data operator is {name}, a professional income tax payer, INN {inn}. For questions about personal data, write to {email}.
privacy.s2.title: 2. What data is processed
privacy.s2.1: Your e-mail address and chosen language, if you sign in by e-mail.
privacy.s2.2: Technical data: the session cookie (a random identifier; only its hash is stored), and your IP address and browser details in the server logs.
privacy.s2.3: Payment records: invoice number, amount, date and status. Card details are entered on Robokassa's page; the operator never receives them.
privacy.s2.4: Drawings and the objects brought to life are linked to your session or account and are visible to everyone in that world.
privacy.s3.title: 3. Why
privacy.s3.1: Signing in with a code sent by e-mail, invitations to private worlds, payment and subscription notices, providing Plus and keeping payment records, protecting the site from abuse, and visit statistics. No marketing e-mails.
privacy.s4.title: 4. Legal grounds
privacy.s4.1: The consent you give when signing in (Article 6(1)(1) of Law No. 152-FZ) and performance of the public offer agreement (Article 6(1)(5)).
privacy.s5.title: 5. Who receives the data
privacy.s5.1: Robokassa (ROBOKASSA LLC, INN 5047063929), to take payments; it processes data under its own policy.
privacy.s5.2: The e-mail service that sends sign-in codes and notices.
privacy.s5.3: The Yandex Advertising Network (YANDEX LLC), which shows ads to visitors without Plus and may use its own cookies under its privacy policy.
privacy.s5.4: A web analytics service, which counts page views and actions on the site so it can be improved.
privacy.s5.5: Data goes to anyone else only where the law requires it.
privacy.s6.title: 6. Storage and protection
privacy.s6.1: Data is stored on servers in the Russian Federation and kept while the account exists or until consent is withdrawn. Payment records are kept as long as the law requires.
privacy.s6.2: The site works only over an encrypted connection (HTTPS). Sign-in codes and session cookies are stored only as hashes. Only the operator has access to the database.
privacy.s7.title: 7. Your rights
privacy.s7.1: You can find out what data about you is stored, correct it, have it deleted and withdraw your consent. Write to {email} from the address in question. You get an answer within 10 working days.
privacy.s7.2: Once consent is withdrawn you can no longer sign in by e-mail; the free part of the site stays open. You may also complain to Roskomnadzor.
privacy.s8.title: 8. Cookies
privacy.s8.1: The site uses a session cookie: sign-in and the daily revival limit need it. Yandex ads and web analytics may set their own cookies. You can turn cookies off in your browser settings.
privacy.s9.title: 9. Changes
privacy.s9.1: A new version of this policy is published on this page and applies from publication.
